inputs: Same retained own RGB-derived masks/cameras/sparse points and supported-fallback depths. Dataset geometry enters posthoc scoring only. Camera control uses own training feature cache with whole reserved components excluded; no supplied dataset poses.
evaluation_policy: Frozen prior scan alignment, camera-only transfer for Bunny, 200000 surface samples per mesh and seed233. No candidate-to-reference refitting. Drill prior reflected-fit ambiguity remains; metrics do not establish handedness.

ray_consensus.method: At fine pixels, inverse-depth bilinear source lookup with all four valid corners and <=1% spread; <=.003 source-depth agreement and <=.5px roundtrip; median of at least3 other-view ray-projected depths, <=.002 relative adjustment; inverse-depth blend; no fill or rejection.
ray_consensus.disabled_control: Strength0 reproduces every value in all60 drill depth arrays exactly. All trials preserve coverage and leave added coarse fallback depths unchanged.

limits: Reference must already be aligned independently; this script does not align it.
Relief uses separately fitted inverse-depth planes on common rays; also inspect absolute error and coverage.
Pointwise metrics can include scan alignment error. Correlation alone is not feature recovery.

ray_consensus.decision: Reject as a general production change: all drill F1 thresholds and symmetric mean error worsen. Bunny strict head F1 rises modestly, but fine (sigma2px) inverse-depth relief RMSE worsens in every measured eye/nose crop; paired renders do not restore missing facial features.

subpixel_fusion.method: Existing fusion_interpolate=true replayed on identical supported-fallback depths. No matching, camera, mask, resolution, truncation or smoothing changes.
subpixel_fusion.decision: No meaningful drill repair. Bunny strict F1 rises slightly while symmetric mean error worsens; not sufficient to recommend this compound setting as a quality upgrade. Existing opt-in remains unchanged.

camera_bundle.method: Original private sparse least-squares control: jointly adjust423 reliable training-track points and59 camera pose deltas, first camera fixed, fixed intrinsics and soft_l1 residuals with camera priors. 250 foreground/173 background training tracks,2807 observations, deterministic selection, reserved components excluded. Evaluation uses fixed baseline eligibility and retriangulates each reserved track independently.

baseline.fit_verified_selection: fixed selection cameras, fitting observations only
limits: Report is meaningful only when cameras were recovered using the partitioned training cache.
False feature matches are included; this diagnostic does not establish dense or local facial accuracy.
Reserved tracks are triangulated using alternating observations; remaining observations score the cameras.

Both candidate and selection cameras must be recovered using the partitioned training cache. Fixed eligibility uses selection cameras and fitting observations only. Candidate points are retriangulated independently. Compare fixed-subset errors only with zero invalid selected observations; invalid observations must not be silently dropped.
Foreground/background labels use photo-derived masks only; mask errors can misclassify observations. Groups do not change fitting or track selection.

camera_bundle.decision: Reject: training median improves but fixed reserved foreground median and p95 both worsen; no dense run with candidate cameras.
camera_bundle.limits: One prior policy, one training subset and this reused reserved diagnostic; not an unbiased final validation set, global optimizer certificate or proof that unconstrained bundle adjustment cannot help.

validation.six_object_gate: Not run for rejected controls; no default or production adoption.
validation.browser: Not run for rejected controls; previous engine browser validation unchanged.

limits: Drill remains open/pitted and Bunny eyes/nose remain weak. None of these controls solves the requested shape quality.
Scanner alignment and scan quality contribute to errors. F1 gains alone do not demonstrate detailed relief recovery.
Local high-pass profiles measure noisy observed depth relief on common rays; they are not independent feature-recognition ground truth.
next_focus: Correct local photometric correspondence and its view support before additional depth averaging or fusion changes; preserve separate reserved-track camera validation.
